citeturn27search5 [wordlim: 200] Published: 7 months ago; Crawled: last month; ## BlackRock Commentary: Dialing down risk amid supply shock

  * March 24, 2026 ... We cut risk and turn neutral U.S. stocks. ... We see a disconnect: A macro shock and hawkish reversal in policy expectations are not consistent with current stock prices. ... All this leads us to trim risk on a tactical horizon. ... The Fed, the ECB and BOE held rates steady, and expectations for 2026 cuts evaporated in the U.S. and turned to multiple hikes in the UK and Europe. ... March 23 : Euro area consumer confidence; Japan CPI, flash PMI
